title: A Pilot Study on HPV and Cervical Cancer Screening in Mumbai
brief_summary: The Study goals are to test feasibility and acceptability of point of care HPV testing with 227 women already accessing an existing cancer screening program in Mumbai, India. Describe HPV infection types in women screened. Compare if the quality of HPV clinician-collected and self-collected samples are equally efficient to detect HPV and cervical cancer precursor lesions. Compare the agreement between HPV GeneXpert and HPV HC2 test on the clinician-collected sample
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Females aged 30 to 55 years (the age when screening for HPV and cervical cancer is recommended) who participate in the TMH cancer screening outreach program.

Exclusion Criteria:

* Women with a known diagnosis of cancer, any other terminal diagnosis, or who are pregnant
